criteria.requirement: Add Table.query_page(cond=None, *, limit=100, after=None) returning (documents,next_cursor). Integer document IDs are sorted ascending, after is exclusive, condition is optional and evaluated on detached Documents. Return at most limit rows; next_cursor is the last returned matching ID only if another match exists, otherwise None. Support sparse IDs, insert/remove between pages, MemoryStorage and JSONStorage. Deep-copy returned data so caller or predicate changes cannot mutate storage. Validate limit 1..1000 and nonnegative integer cursor, excluding booleans. This is keyset pagination, without snapshot/concurrent-writer guarantees.
